title: Manufacturing and Trade: Inventories and Sales (October 2026 data) — the retail-inventories closer, 10:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: census.gov/economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes, all 179 rows parsed), row "Manufacturing and Trade: Inventories and Sales | December 16, 2026 | 10:00 AM | October 2026", release code A202612161000, reference A202610. Corroborated by the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx PostedUpdates sheet, whose 2026-12-16 10:00 row reads "Retail sales + inventories, Industrial production". Filed estimate per the lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the wholesale-trade-2026-12-09 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06), and it closes a hole the proposal that created that event described inexactly. The Advance Economic Indicators Report of 2026-11-27 previews THREE October data lines and they close on THREE dates: goods trade -> intl-trade-full-report-2026-12-08 (tracked), wholesale inventories -> wholesale-trade-2026-12-09 (tracked), retail inventories -> this release. The 11-27 proposal read the wholesale print as closing "the retail/wholesale inventories half"; it closes only the wholesale half. NOTE THE COLLISION RISK IN THE EXISTING CALENDAR: retail-sales-2026-12-16 is already tracked, but it is the 08:30 Advance Monthly Retail Trade report for NOVEMBER data (A202612160830) — a different release, a different reference month, and a different hour on the same day. Reading the tracked entry as the October retail-inventories closer would be wrong. Why it earns a row: MTIS is the release that folds the wholesale numbers from the 12-09 print, retail inventories, and manufacturing inventories into the single business-inventories aggregate BEA carries into GDP, so it is where the 12-09 print's own contribution is superseded one week later. Also the last of the three closers to land, seven days after this proposer's event and five days past the 2026-12-11 funding cliff — the first Census release of this October reference cycle that is NOT inside the funded window, which makes it the corridor's genuine lapse-exposure test rather than the 12-08/12-09 pair. Impact LOW, symbols empty: no house playbook is macro-keyed and no instrument attaches. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
